C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtracting.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction parts inside mixed-number subtraction as well as pure fractions.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing steps that add a full denominator unit after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes denominator matching.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole and fraction parts separately after rewriting or aligning denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding an LCD or converting equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification-only steps after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow or regroup one whole into fractional units when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when a step converts the borrowed whole into denominator-sized fractional units such as 5/5, 10/10, 12/12, or 24/24.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no borrowing is needed.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless the solution then performs borrowing.
Do not tag simplification after regrouped subtraction is finished.

skills.name: Rewrite mixed or whole
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number or whole number into a subtraction-friendly form, such as normalizing an improper mixed number or expressing a whole as a whole plus zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when an improper mixed number like 2 3/2 is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align with a fractional or mixed-number form.
Tag when a mixed number is decomposed into whole and fractional parts for separate subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting equivalent fractions for unlike denominators.
Do not tag subtraction itself after the rewriting is complete.
Do not tag final combining of parts into the answer.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or simplify a zero fractional part to an integer or whole-number result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0/d is simplified to 0.
Tag when the final answer is rewritten from an unsimplified fractional form to lowest terms.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-term result without any simplification action shown.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts unless simplification is explicitly performed there.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.

skills.name: Combine final parts
skills.definition: Assemble the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into one mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is dropped to express the answer as a fraction.
Tag when whole and fractional results are combined into an integer because the fractional part is zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction of the parts themselves.
Do not tag simplification-only steps unless they also explicitly combine parts into the final form.
Do not tag rewriting at the start of the problem.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtracting.
Tag for unlike fractional parts in pure-fraction or mixed-number subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag steps that only subtract numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of creating a common denominator for an unlike-denominator fraction pair.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a nonstandard mixed number or whole-number term into a compatible whole-plus-fraction form for subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus zero fractional part, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5 or 2 to 2 + 0/8.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts to align subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion of fractions.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole and fraction parts separately after setup.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag simplification of the result after subtraction.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted to d/d and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag simplification after regrouping is complete.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 or an equivalent simpler form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0/d is simplified to 0.
Tag when simplification is explicitly stated in the solution.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag if the result is already in lowest terms and no simplification step is shown.
Do not tag recombining whole and fractional parts unless reduction also occurs in that step.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts, or recognize that the result is a whole number or proper fraction, and state the final answer in acceptable form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into a mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when the solution explicitly combines parts to produce the final stated result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself.
Do not tag simplification unless the step's main action is forming the final presented answer from computed parts.
Do not tag setup steps that only rewrite operands before subtraction.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to create like denominators before subtracting.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts need denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing steps that add a whole denominator unit such as 12/12 or 5/5 after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number part unless denominators are being matched across two different fractions.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole and fractional parts separately after rewriting or aligning the numbers.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag simplification-only steps after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow one whole and convert it to fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution shows a negative fractional difference and then borrows from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-sized fractional units such as 5/5, 10/10, 12/12, or 24/24.
Tag for whole-minus-fraction or mixed-minus-fraction problems that require regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no borrowing is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part unless borrowing actually occurs later.
Do not tag simplification after regrouped subtraction is finished.

skills.name: Rewrite mixed or whole
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting a whole number to a mixed form with 0 fractional part or separating a mixed number into whole and fraction parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator, such as 2 + 0/3 or 2 + 0/8.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly rewritten as whole plus fraction to support part-by-part subtraction.
Tag when the rewrite prepares the numbers for later subtraction but does not itself perform borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number part into a standard mixed number; that belongs to a different skill.
Do not tag finding common denominators.
Do not tag final combining of parts into the answer.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2, 2 4/3, or 1 5/3 is rewritten as an equivalent mixed number with a proper fractional part.
Tag when the solver explicitly states 'normalize' or performs the equivalent conversion.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary mixed-number rewriting into whole plus fraction when the fractional part is already proper.
Do not tag common-denominator conversions between two fractions.
Do not tag borrowing one whole during subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero fractional part to an integer or simpler mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when the final mixed number is simplified because its fractional part can be reduced.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a fraction in lowest terms with no explicit simplification.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts unless simplification also occurs in that step.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
